overview.title: Overview
overview.noSitesText: Create your first site to get a tracking ID and start the guided setup.

onboarding.orgText: Sites, team members, destinations and billing belong to an organization. You can rename it later.
onboarding.siteText: We create the site with a public six-character tracking ID. Domain ownership is verified in the next step.

errors.orgName: Enter a name with 2 to 80 characters.
errors.domain: Enter a valid domain such as shop.example.com.
errors.limit: Your plan does not allow more sites. Upgrade to add another one.
errors.generic: That did not work. Please try again.

site.trackingIdHelp: Public, immutable and never reused. It is not a secret.
site.snippetText: Add this asynchronous script to every page, ideally in the head. It does not block rendering and fails safe.
site.verifyText: Choose one method. Verification is required before production tracking is published.
site.dnsHelp: Add a TXT record on {host} with this value:
site.metaHelp: Add this tag to the head of your home page:

debugger.title: Event debugger
debugger.intro: Every event with its lineage: source, consent snapshot, processing state, click ids and the delivery attempt per destination (redacted payloads).
debugger.empty: No events match. Send a test event from a destination wizard or install the snippet.
debugger.selectEvent: Select an event to see consent, routing and vendor payloads.
debugger.noAttempts: No delivery attempts for this event.

events.title: Events
events.intro: Accepted and dropped events per day for the last 7 days.
events.empty: No events in the last 7 days.

team.title: Team
team.intro: Members, roles and invitations for this organization. Roles are enforced server-side on every action and tool call.
team.inviteText: The invitation is sent by e-mail and expires after 7 days.

roles.OWNER: Everything, including billing, deletion and ownership transfer.
roles.ADMIN: Manage sites, destinations, consent, team and settings.
roles.DEVELOPER: Configure sites, destinations, credentials and publish.
roles.ANALYST: Read events, health and configuration; run the assistant read-only.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Organization, preferences, per-site kill switches and server-side source keys.
settings.aiEnabled: AI assistant enabled for this organization
settings.killSwitch: Organization kill switch: stop all collection and delivery immediately
settings.keysText: Source keys authenticate server-side events (POST /v1/s). Only a hash is stored; the key is shown once.
settings.keyOnce: Copy it now — it will not be shown again.
settings.readOnly: Your role can view these settings only.

billing.title: Billing
billing.intro: Plan, usage and invoices. Payment data is handled by Stripe; we store only the customer and subscription ids.
billing.checkoutSuccess: Thank you — the subscription is being activated.
billing.stripeMissing: Stripe is not configured on this platform yet (STRIPE_* environment). Plans are shown for reference.
billing.readOnly: Your role can view billing only.

errors.no_customer: No Stripe customer yet — choose a plan first.

quality.title: Data quality
quality.intro: Tracking health score and detected issues per site, with the assistant tool that fixes each one.
quality.noSnapshot: No snapshot yet — the worker computes it hourly.

audiences.title: Audiences
audiences.intro: Consent-aware segments computed from first-party events of the last 30 days (marketing consent only, sample of the latest 1,000 events per type).
audiences.consentNote: {n} events without marketing consent were excluded. Inferred consent is never used for audiences.
audiences.how1: track.site never uploads audience lists. Each platform receives only the individual server conversions with hashed matching data that the visitor consented to.
audiences.how2: Use the platform's own audience builder on those conversions (e.g. Meta custom audiences from CAPI events, Google Ads conversion-based audiences).
audiences.how3: Withdrawn consent stops future sends immediately and can be enforced retroactively through a data subject request.

privacy.title: Consent & privacy
privacy.intro: Consent policies per site, retention windows and data subject requests. Everything here is audited.
privacy.noPolicies: No consent policy yet — the setup assistant creates one.
privacy.retentionText: Days per data kind for this organization (defaults from the platform policy). Shorter windows apply at the next retention run.
privacy.dsarText: Requests are processed against pseudonymous identifiers only: the e-mail is hashed before it is stored. Export produces a downloadable JSON, delete removes the subject's events and conversion records across the organization's sites.
